title: Enterprise feature funnel & rulebook for multi-output chat + toolcalls
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Create a single, enforceable rulebook for how enterprise feature requests that touch chat, streaming, tool/function calling, or structured outputs are triaged, prioritized, and routed. Current intake is fragmented across support, AE, and product; enterprise customers expect deterministic outcomes when requests affect compliance, latency SLAs, or require Dedicated/Private deployments. This ticket defines the scoring signals, automatic routing rules, gating criteria for security/compliance review, and an escalation path for high-risk toolcall/streaming features.
acceptance_criteria: Clear scoring rubric that assigns a numeric priority to each incoming enterprise request based on defined signals (SLA risk, data residency, PII, throughput impact, business value)
Automated routing rules that map score ranges to next steps: self-serve roadmap backlog, product discovery, engineering scoping, or Dedicated/Private engagement
Checklist of gating criteria that triggers mandatory security/compliance review (e.g., arbitrary code execution, external tool integrations, PII exfiltration risk)
Example routes and sample handling for five representative requests (streaming large result sets, function-calling with external webhooks, structured JSON outputs for billing integrations)
Operational playbook for notifying AE/CS, setting SLAs for response, and creating a canonical tracker for enterprise feature status
proposed_flow: 1) Intake channel records request with structured form fields (customer tier, workload type, data classification, desired routing). 2) System runs scoring engine (weights: SLA risk 25, compliance 25, security 20, revenue potential 15, engineering effort 15). 3) Score buckets: 0-29: Low -> Backlog; 30-59: Medium -> PM discovery; 60-79: High -> Eng scoping + security review; 80-100: Immediate -> Dedicated/Private engagement + executive alert. 4) If request includes tool/function calls or streaming > 5k tokens per minute, add automatic probe: perf impact estimation and recommended Dedicated config. 5) If structured outputs are required for billing/regulated workflows, attach data residency and audit logging templates. 6) Notify AE/CS via standard template and create cross-functional ticket with linked security and infra checklists.
notes: Weighting above is preliminary; run historical replay against last 18 months of enterprise requests to calibrate thresholds
Avoid over-prioritizing revenue-only signals without quantifying operational cost to serve (ops cost per 1k tokens, expected resource delta)
Recommend enabling a short 'fast-track' channel for existing top-20 customers with a separate SLA and CTO review
Consider integration with Redwood Console to display intake status and per-request cost/latency impact estimates
